prompt:
Goal: Create a polished vertical Japanese TV anime announcement poster for a fictional series starring CANDY GIRL, with a luxurious sci-fi girls-action mystery atmosphere.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, full-bleed illustration with a thin white outer margin. High-resolution anime key visual, dramatic cinematic lighting, elegant fantasy sci-fi design.

Main subject: One tall glamorous anime heroine stands centered in a grand luminous cathedral-like glass palace. She has long flowing wavy blonde hair, bright blue eyes, confident serious expression, and sunlit highlights. Outfit is entirely white and gold: exactly 8 visible outfit/accessory elements: 1 white hood, 1 cropped white tank top, 1 off-shoulder long-sleeve jacket, 1 high-waisted white trouser set, 1 wide gold belt, 1 long translucent overskirt/train, 1 pair of white heeled boots, and 1 dangling gold chain accessory. Pose: full-body front-facing fashion stance, one hand relaxed, hair and fabric flowing as if in a gentle breeze.

Background: Vast arched glass-and-metal conservatory or cathedral interior with circular window behind her head like a halo, tall columns, prismatic reflections, sparkling particles, lens flares, soft blue-white light rays, faint gold magical glyph accents. Mood is sacred, futuristic, mysterious, and premium.

Layout and text: Japanese anime magazine/poster typography with glowing white and gold serif lettering. Include exactly 9 main text areas: 1 top-left black ribbon reading 「もしもCANDY GIRLが アニメになったら？」, 1 right-top announcement reading 「TVアニメ化 決定」, 1 small genre block reading 「ジャンル：SF×ガールズアクション ×ミステリー」, 1 left vertical catchphrase under a small plaque 「キャッチコピー」 with the phrase 「甘くきらめくその笑顔が、閉ざされた楽園の真実を暴き出す。」, 1 huge central title logo reading LUMINA CANDY, 1 small Japanese subtitle beneath it reading 「—ルミナキャンディ—」, 1 lower-left synopsis block under plaque 「短いあらすじ」, 1 lower name/CV block reading 「キャラクター名：CANDY GIRL」 and 「CV：早見沙織」, and 1 bottom release line reading 「2026年 TVアニメ放送開始」.

Synopsis text: In small elegant Japanese text, include a fictional short synopsis about a girl awakening in the fully managed city Lumina Garden, losing her memories, discovering a body that contains light particles that can rewrite the world, and seeking the truth behind the radiance while opening the door of fate.

Additional emblem: Add exactly 1 circular ornate gold emblem at lower right with starburst decoration, small blue diamond jewel, and Japanese motto text: 「光は記憶 記憶は歌、歌は希望。」

Visual style: Premium modern anime key art, semi-realistic detailed face, glossy rendering, intricate hair strands, clean linework, ethereal white-blue-gold palette, high contrast glow, elegant fantasy UI ornaments, ornate title design with a star flare inside the title. Make it look like an official 2026 TV anime adaptation announcement poster.

Constraints: Use exactly one character, no extra characters, no chibi art, no manga panels, no English translation captions besides the romanized title and project copyright. Keep all Japanese text legible and placed like a professional promotional poster.
